title: Cultural resonance in the brain: EEG-based insights into emotional engagement with festive imagery
core_idea: Use electroencephalography to compare neural engagement—measures of cognitive load, emotional arousal, neural stimulation, and frontal activation—in Kolkata participants viewing culturally familiar (Durga Puja) versus unfamiliar (Onam) festive images, to assess how cultural familiarity, novelty, and visual symbolism modulate attention and affective processing.
tldr: This study uses non-invasive EEG to investigate how cultural familiarity and the visual richness of festival images influence neural markers of attention and emotion in Kolkata viewers.
